verses.1: What Esaiah son of Amoz saw regarding Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.2: And in the days to come, the mountain of God will be located at the top of the mountains. It will be lifted up from its foundations, and all the nations will flow towards it.
verses.3: And many nations went and said, “Let us go up to Mount Yahweh, to the house of God where Jacob resides. Let us follow his ways and walk in his paths. For from Zion will come the word of Yahweh, and from Jerusalem will come God’s message.”
verses.4: And he will judge among the nations, and he will bring about the destruction of many peoples. Their ruins will become places of lamentation; no nation will be able to rise from its ruins, nor will they be able to learn anything from those wars.
verses.5: House of Jacob, let us go! Let us walk in the light of Jehovah.
verses.6: For you have abandoned your people, the house of Jacob. They are full of sin and corruption; they are like Canaanites and foreigners who do evil deeds.
verses.7: And its land was filled with gold and silver. There was no end to its treasures. Its land was also filled with horses, and there was no end to its chariots.
verses.8: And its land was filled with idols, as a result of their actions. They would worship those who had created them.
verses.9: And man shall be humiliated, and one shall be despised. Do not lift them up in your mind.
verses.10: Enter into the pit, and be buried in it out of fear of the LORD.
verses.11: The eyes of a proud man will be lowered, and he will be humbled. On that day, only Jehovah will be exalted.
verses.12: For the day of Jehovah’s army will be upon every high place and mountain, and upon every lofty tree.
verses.13: And on all those high, towering palm trees, and on all those thorny bushes.
verses.14: And on all the high mountains, and on all the steep cliffs.
verses.15: And on every high mountain, and on every city in its shape.
verses.16: And upon all nations, and upon all those who are greedy.
verses.17: And the pride of man will be crushed, and people will become humble. Only Jehovah will remain strong on that day.
verses.18: And the idols will all be destroyed.
verses.19: And they came into the wildernesses and into the deserts out of fear of the Lord. They fled from the dangers that lay ahead, in order to live in those places.
verses.20: On that day, man will throw away his idols made of wood and his idols made of gold, which he used to worship the idols of the gods.
verses.21: To enter through the caves of the Jews and among the rocks out of fear of Jehovah, and from the danger of their rebellion, when they go into the wilderness.
verses.22: Stop regarding those people as beings who have souls in their bodies. After all, they are not considered to be real human beings at all.
